purpose: Implementation and old-data calibration only; no independent validation data generation or inspection
query_implementations: unchanged base.query for direct; unchanged bbox_ablation.query_h3_bbox(profile=False) for all H3
feature: point-weighted fraction: r7 boundary cell AND inclusive region bounding rectangle; cell classification deduplicated with inverse mapping
extra_decision: sample_four starts from SAME B; switch only to minimum of r6/r8 with Cextra<0.98*CB; exact r6/r8 tie prefers r6
raw_argmin: record unconservative minimum of all four predicted costs, not a separate timed policy
floating_comparison_tolerance: 1e-12 milliseconds absolute for mathematical equality at analytic breakpoints, not an additional engineering margin

model.prepare: median of 4 case medians of method-specific preparation, using this run K1000 trials
model.common_geometry: median of 4 case medians; recorded separately, genuinely reused
model.query_y: per case median of continuous_queries_ns/1000 using normal K1000 path
model.query_fit: equal-weight ordinary least squares on FOUR independent case aggregates: q=a+b*f
model.feature_x: offline exact r7 after-bbox count/10032, never passed to online selector
model.clip: online f clipped to minimum/maximum calibration f, raw f also retained
model.K_only_query: equal-weight mean of four normal case query costs
model.K100: prediction check only; does not add observations or parameters to query fit

reuse: common geometry created/prepared once and passed by identity; sample encodings and local polygon classes discarded, not credited against full preparation
main_timing: one outer interval common geometry + method-specific preparation + K normal queries; all fixed methods randomly interleaved in the SAME round
selector_timing: fresh common geometry measured separately; each policy independently reruns sampling, four-cost prediction, and decision; logging outside timers
diagnostics: extra phase clocks only in separate selector diagnostic trials; normal complete selection time is authoritative
offline_costs: wall stage durations and sum of measured core intervals reported separately; no zero-cost calibration claim
